title: Getting Started with Next.js 14
subtitle: A comprehensive guide to building modern web apps with Next.js App Router
content:
Introduction

Next.js 14 introduces powerful new features that make building full-stack web applications easier than ever. In this guide, we'll explore the App Router, Server Components, and more.

App Router

The App Router is the new paradigm for building Next.js applications. It leverages React Server Components by default, giving you incredible performance out of the box.

Server Components

Server Components run exclusively on the server, allowing you to access databases and APIs directly without exposing sensitive information to the client.

Conclusion

Next.js 14 is a massive step forward for the React ecosystem. Whether you're building a simple blog or a complex SaaS app, Next.js has the tools you need.

title: The Art of UX Design
subtitle: How to create experiences that users actually love
content:
What is UX?

User Experience design is about crafting products that provide meaningful and relevant experiences to users. This involves the design of the entire process of acquiring and integrating the product, including aspects of branding, design, usability, and function.

Key Principles

Great UX design follows a handful of core principles: user-centricity, consistency, hierarchy, context, user control, accessibility, and usability.

Design Process

The design process typically involves research, ideation, prototyping, testing, and iteration. Never skip user research — it's the foundation of great design.

title: TypeScript Best Practices in 2024
subtitle: Write cleaner, safer, and more maintainable TypeScript code
content:
Why TypeScript?

TypeScript adds static typing to JavaScript, catching errors at compile time rather than runtime. In 2024, it's become the de-facto standard for large-scale JavaScript projects.

Use Strict Mode

Always enable strict: true in your tsconfig. This enables a suite of strict type-checking options that will save you from many common bugs.

Prefer Interfaces Over Type Aliases

For object shapes, prefer interface over type. Interfaces are more performant and support declaration merging.

Avoid Any

The any type defeats the purpose of TypeScript. Use unknown instead when you don't know the type, and narrow it properly.
